evidence.purpose: Meta ad sets: spend, platform-reported revenue and budget-limited share, last 7 and last 3 days
evidence.sql:
SELECT a.adset_id AS line_id, a.adset_name AS name, a.daily_budget_usd AS daily_budget,
  sum(d.spend_usd) AS spend_7, sum(d.revenue_reported_usd) AS platform_revenue_7,
  sum(CASE WHEN d.report_date >= DATE '2026-10-16' THEN d.spend_usd END) AS spend_3,
  sum(CASE WHEN d.report_date >= DATE '2026-10-16' THEN d.revenue_reported_usd END) AS platform_revenue_3,
  round(avg(d.budget_lost_share), 3) AS budget_lost_share_7
FROM meta_pg.adset_daily d JOIN meta_pg.adsets a ON a.adset_id = d.adset_id
WHERE d.report_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
GROUP BY a.adset_id, a.adset_name, a.daily_budget_usd

evidence.purpose: Google campaigns: cost, platform-reported conversion value and budget-lost impression share, last 7 and last 3 days
evidence.sql:
SELECT c.campaign_id AS line_id, c.campaign_name AS name, c.daily_budget_usd AS daily_budget,
  sum(d.cost_usd) AS spend_7, sum(d.conv_value_reported_usd) AS platform_revenue_7,
  sum(CASE WHEN d.report_date >= DATE '2026-10-16' THEN d.cost_usd END) AS spend_3,
  sum(CASE WHEN d.report_date >= DATE '2026-10-16' THEN d.conv_value_reported_usd END) AS platform_revenue_3,
  round(avg(d.search_lost_is_budget), 3) AS budget_lost_share_7
FROM google_pg.campaign_daily d JOIN google_pg.campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = d.campaign_id
WHERE d.report_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.daily_budget_usd

evidence.purpose: Backend revenue by ad line from orders (governed view, no customer identity), last 7 and last 3 days
evidence.sql:
SELECT utm_id AS line_id, sum(revenue_usd) AS backend_revenue_7,
  sum(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-10-16' THEN revenue_usd END) AS backend_revenue_3, sum(orders) AS orders_7
FROM autopilot.revenue_by_line_daily
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
